Purpose: Compare pseudotime distributions between WT and KO cells
Justification: Wilcoxon test was used because pseudotime is continuous, non-normal, and often skewed in trajectory analyses
Interpretation: Tests whether WT and KO cells differ in their overall relative pseudotime positions

Purpose: Test whether WT and KO differ in annotated cell-type occupancy
Justification: Chi-square test was used because cell-type occupancy is categorical count data across genotype groups
Interpretation: Tests whether WT and KO cells are distributed differently across author-annotated differentiation states

Purpose: Test whether WT and KO differ in Seurat cluster occupancy
Justification: Chi-square test was used because cluster occupancy is categorical count data across genotype groups
Interpretation: Tests whether WT and KO cells are distributed differently across unsupervised Seurat clusters
